usage.train: Resolve only splits.train IDs through episodes, then read each absolute episode directory. Never glob failed episodes into BC training.
usage.evaluation: Validation and test are unrecorded scenario definitions for learner evaluation. They have no demonstration files and zero recorded decisions. source_line is one-based in the immutable JSONL source.
usage.authority: All physical scenario parameters and seed/command_seed come from the episode.json. Structural IDs/split membership and eligibility use the finalized central summary when absent from three early raw metadata files. Frozen candidate defaults never replace recorded parameters.
usage.resplit: Membership is frozen before outcomes; do not randomly split decisions, recorded episodes, variants of one object place, moving region or jump site.

split_policy.cross_family_overlap: The original task preserves family-specific spatial splits. Road training spans all six regions, including onar/lobart held out for moving targets; object and jump groups can also share broader regions. Evaluation is not a claim of unseen geography across all families.

point.rule: Both directions of every validation/test route are excluded from road, object and moving collection. Road regions are balanced, not held out.

object.evaluation_qualification: Same pre-existing geometry/visibility rule as training: supported start, visible centre or opening edge, complete detour, valid positive direct distance, detour >=1.5*direct or straight_blocked, historical route isolation; no v3 outcome filter.

eligibility.object: episode.success is true after visible-object scenario qualification
eligibility.jump: episode.transition_success is true: goal reached, required action and transition/landing-side evidence all pass demo_goal_action_landing_side_v1
eligibility.follow_below_gate: Explicit tagged family: full horizon, surviving actor and target, first contact, positive observed follow duration, time-weighted 2-5 m fraction >=0.70. Native teacher success uses >=0.80 and is preserved separately.

rejected_candidates.reason: Runner rejected advance: navdemos moving route needs distinct connected points
